title: Railway RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026
summary: Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC-NR) , has released a Notification on its official website for the recruitment of RRC NR Apprentice Posts. This recruitment is for 4651 positions. RRC Application Form has started on 11 November 2026 & the candidates can apply until 11 December 2026 . Candidates must check the complete details for RRC NR Apprentice Recruitment 2026. which has given below.
qualification: All candidates who have passed Class 10th with 50% marks from any recognized board in India are eligible to apply for this recruitment. Candidates must also possess an ITI Certificate in the relevant trade/branch .
selection_process: Related Posts CISCE ICSE Board Class 10th & 12th Date Sheet 2027 UPSC Engineering Services Pre Exam Schedule 2027 RRB ALP CEN 01/2026 Vacancy Increased 2026 BSF Constable Tradesman Written Exam / Admit Card Notice 2026 NICL Administrative Officer Pre Admit Card 2026
